component.name: L-ai-SERcraft
component.summary: GRBL laser engraver and cutter controller

description.p: L-ai-SERcraft generates G-code from images and SVG files and streams it to GRBL laser machines. It runs on Linux, Windows and macOS.
It is a modified version of LaserGRBL 7.14.1 by Diego Settimi (arkypita) and the LaserGRBL contributors, ported to Rust, and adds per-layer SVG settings, named layer presets and hatch fill.
L-ai-SERcraft is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Diego Settimi or the LaserGRBL project.
